28:t_005:3.en:
???
「Leave it to us when it comes to that!」

28:t_006:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ワッ太$$! And $$正太郎$$ too!」

28:t_006:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's so mean! You left us behind again!」

28:t_006:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「This fight's in Tokyo this time, so you can't pull the 'protect Japan' line on us!」

28:t_006:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$ told me. That $n and the others were worried about us, so they told us to stay home.」

28:t_006:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've been ready to fight for ages, no matter who the enemy is!」

28:t_006:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We've got things we need to protect too!」

28:t_006:11.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We're not the only ones who think that way.」

28:t_007:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「EVA...! Is that $$シンジ$$ and the others!?」

28:t_007:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Sorry we're late...! $$綾波$$ and I will fight too!」

28:t_007:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「《$$ＮＥＲＶ$$》 is going to back us up...」

28:t_007:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You got through to that father of yours...!?」

28:t_007:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It took a while, but in the end he told me to do as I please and authorized our sortie.」

28:t_007:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They're not as much kids as you think they are.」

28:t_007:8.en:
$$マオ$$
「Besides, it's ten years too early for a brat to be worrying about other brats.」

28:t_007:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone... I understand you're fired up, but don't rush, okay?」

28:t_007:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Because to me, $$ワッ太$$ and the others and all of you are equally people I have to protect.」

28:t_007:13.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's right. From where Miss $$スズネ$$ and I stand, even you guys are just $$ワッ太$$ with a few hairs sprouted.」

28:t_007:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well, well... I wonder how the Volunteer Club's Madonna teacher took that...」

28:t_007:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-Well... that's not what I meant...!」

28:t_007:20.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-What's that for, even all of you...!」

28:t_007:21.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What does that mean, $$キャシー$$?」

28:t_007:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n, stop laughing under your breath!」

28:t_007:25.en:
$$テッサ$$
「E-Everyone...! We're in the middle of a battle!」

28:t_007:26.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Even so, the pressure that hung over the unit is gone.」

28:t_007:27.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Come on, you brats! The enemy's been waiting for you!」

28:t_008:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's go, $$宗介$$! If you hate being on the protected side, prove it!」

28:t_008:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Protecting or being protected, it makes no difference. We're comrades.」

28:t_008:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Nice talk! All right, let's go with a combo!」

28:t_009:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's teach that big lug a lesson! Boys, are you ready!?」

28:t_010:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「How do you like that, big guy! With this many attacks pounding you, you won't even have time to put up your precious barrier!」

28:t_011:0.en:
$n
「It's holding itself together with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」

28:t_012:1.en:
$$アル$$
「$$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ confirmed operating normally. That was not a bad attack.」

28:t_012:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Listening to that roundabout way of talking, I see there really is a problem with your brain.」

28:t_012:3.en:
$$アル$$
「I will save words of praise until after the enemy is annihilated. Or do you intend to commit the third-rate folly of feeling sure of victory with enemy forces still remaining?」

28:t_012:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up. As you wish, I'll clear out the rest right away.」

28:t_013:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Amazing... $$マオ$$, $$クルツ$$, $$宗介$$ too...」

28:t_013:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We can't let ourselves be outdone!」

28:t_013:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If we don't make a name for ourselves here, there's no point in us having come!」

28:t_013:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Go for it, $$鉄人$$! $$オックス$$!」

28:t_013:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The enemy's trump-card reinforcements have been struck down and their morale is dropping! Press the attack all at once!」

28:t_014:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「So we managed to win somehow...」

28:t_014:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ and the others are pursuing the enemy soldiers who escaped.」

28:t_014:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Since today's raid was only a probe, I doubt they sent in any important troops, though...」

28:t_014:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Even so, we got something out of it.」

28:t_014:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Indeed. It's lightened my mood a little.」

28:t_015:0.en:
$n
「Thanks, $$ワッ太$$. You too, $$正太郎$$, $$オックス$$, $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#pt394$$.」

28:t_015:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you mean that, treat me to Galaxy Ramen, and not just Trident-yaki.」

28:t_015:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry, $n. ...This time all of us were saved by $$ワッ太$$ and the others... In short, we've still got a long way to go too.」

28:t_015:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's the idea, $$マオ$$. Kids will act like kids and be looked after by the grown-ups.」

kept_omissions: 28:t_005:2: 'Damn...! At this rate...' - subject/object left open (the party's predicament).
28:t_007:2: Kouji's 'NERV is going to back us up...' - kept as a trailing statement as in the source.
28:t_011:0: $n - 'It's holding itself together...' subject taken as the enemy machine (Behemoth AS) per earlier slice.
28:t_012:0: Sousuke's 'Enemy AS destruction confirmed...!' impersonal report, as in source.
28:t_014:0: Otto 'So we managed to win somehow...' subject 'we' supplied; 28:t_014:3 Jeffrey 'we got something out of it' likewise.
uncertain: 28:t_015:1/2: Watta's 'treat me to Galaxy Ramen' - 'me' chosen because Shotaro answers 'Of course, and us too' (僕達にも); the object is unstated in Japanese and could be 'us'.
28:t_007:13: 'Watta with a few hairs sprouted' keeps the lewd reading Suzune objects to (ハレンチ); 毛が生えた is idiomatic 'only slightly above'.
28:t_013:5: Rei speaker token pt394 (Rei Ayanami, female; Shinji addresses her as Ayanami); Jigoku 'Yeah' kept.
28:t_013:6/t_015:0: 'Ox' rendered by tokens $$オックス$$ (robot, proposed) in speech and $$ブラックオックス#pilot$$ as speaker; 鉄人 token = Tetsujin (pilot).
28:t_013:3: 社長 rendered 'President' (Watta is 'elementary school president' in dlg_2004_00), not 'Boss' to avoid clash with the character Boss.
28:t_006:6: $c = squad name; 28:t_006:7 'we're $c too' relies on the squad name fitting as a predicate.
28:t_006:6: $n presumed to refer to the protagonist in an 'and the others' phrase (さん達).
28:t_007:4: Michel's 'that father of yours' = Gendo (scene-settled via Shinji's reply).
28:t_008:0: Mao's ソースケ rendered with token $$宗介$$ (Sousuke).
28:t_014:1: 少佐 rendered 'Major', Kalinin 'and the others'.

28:t_015:5: Alto's 'Don't worry' aimed at $n's protest about paying; No glossary entry for 'Galaxy Ramen' (銀河ラーメン) and 'AS' (ＡＳ), 'Lambda Driver' (ラムダ・ドライバ), 'EVA' are not in the glossary sheet, rendered literally.
